officialTitle: Nivolumab and Ipilimumab as Maintenance Therapy in Extensive-Disease Small-Cell Lung Cancer: CheckMate 451
setting: Maintenance after first-line platinum chemotherapy in extensive-stage SCLC

design.notes: Three-arm 1:1:1 randomisation in patients without progression after up to four cycles of first-line chemotherapy. Secondary endpoints were hierarchically tested.

clinicalQuestion: Does maintenance nivolumab plus ipilimumab (or nivolumab alone) after first-line chemotherapy prolong survival in extensive-disease SCLC?

pico.population: Extensive-disease SCLC, ECOG PS 0-1, no progression after up to four cycles of first-line platinum chemotherapy
pico.intervention: Maintenance nivolumab plus ipilimumab, or nivolumab monotherapy
pico.outcomes: Primary: OS with nivolumab plus ipilimumab vs placebo. Secondary: OS with nivolumab, PFS

arms.label: Nivolumab + ipilimumab
arms.dosing: Nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 3 mg/kg every 3 weeks for 12 weeks, then nivolumab 240 mg every 2 weeks
arms.doseSourceQuote: randomly assigned (1:1:1) to nivolumab 1 mg/kg plus ipilimumab 3 mg/kg once every 3 weeks for 12 weeks followed by nivolumab 240 mg once every 2 weeks, nivolumab 240 mg once every 2 weeks, or placebo for ≤ 2 years or until progression or unacceptable toxicity

arms.label: Nivolumab
arms.doseSourceQuote: nivolumab 240 mg once every 2 weeks, or placebo for ≤ 2 years or until progression or unacceptable toxicity

publications.title: Nivolumab and Ipilimumab as Maintenance Therapy in Extensive-Disease Small-Cell Lung Cancer: CheckMate 451.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: The minimum follow-up was 8.9 months. OS was not significantly prolonged with nivolumab plus ipilimumab versus placebo (hazard ratio [HR], 0.92; 95% CI, 0.75 to 1.12;= .37; median, 9.29.6 months).
The HR for OS with nivolumab versus placebo was 0.84 (95% CI, 0.69 to 1.02); the median OS for nivolumab was 10.4 months.
Progression-free survival HRs versus placebo were 0.72 for nivolumab plus ipilimumab (95% CI, 0.60 to 0.87) and 0.67 for nivolumab (95% CI, 0.56 to 0.81).
Progression-free survival HRs versus placebo were 0.72 for nivolumab plus ipilimumab (95% CI, 0.60 to 0.87) and 0.67 for nivolumab (95% CI, 0.56 to 0.81).

safety.description: Grade 3-4 treatment-related adverse events (nivolumab + ipilimumab vs placebo; nivolumab monotherapy 11.5%)
safety.sourceQuote: Rates of grade 3-4 treatment-related adverse events were nivolumab plus ipilimumab (52.2%), nivolumab (11.5%), and placebo (8.4%).

strengths: Large double-blind randomised phase III trial
Clinically relevant maintenance question after chemotherapy
limitations: Immunotherapy started only after chemotherapy rather than concurrently, unlike the positive first-line trials
Substantially higher grade 3-4 toxicity with the combination

clinicalImplications.text: Maintenance nivolumab plus ipilimumab after chemotherapy did not prolong OS in extensive-disease SCLC and added toxicity; sequential checkpoint maintenance is not supported by this trial.

tumourBoardPearl.text: PFS improved without OS benefit: in extensive-stage SCLC, the positive immunotherapy trials started checkpoint blockade concurrently with induction chemotherapy.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 33683919. The median OS values for the primary comparison appear garbled in the PubMed abstract ('9.29.6 months') and were therefore not transcribed. No registry ID is printed in the abstract. Arm sizes not reported in the abstract.
